newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle market light at $65 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle market light at $65 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was rather slow, with slaughter steers and heifers steady, USDA said. Inquiry good, demand moderate. Sales confirmed on 4,200 slaughter steers and 2,100 slaughter heifers Thursday.
For the week to date 86,200 head confirmed including 27,200 head or about 32 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1170-1200 lbs 65.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1010 lbs 65.00.
